Who is Pixelbrahma?

Pixelbrahma Design Studio Pvt Ltd is a design and technology studio with offices in Bengaluru, Kochi and Brampton (Canada) that has been creating customer experiences for more than 20 years.

Why businesses work with Pixelbrahma

One team, clear communication and more than 20 years of experience behind every project.

  1. 01

    One partner, three disciplines

    Product, marketing and brand are planned together, so nothing is lost between agencies.

  2. 02

    Two decades of craft

    We have been creating customer experiences for more than 20 years.

  3. 03

    Presence in India and Canada

    Teams in Bengaluru, Kochi and Brampton can support markets on both sides.

  4. 04

    Plain, honest communication

    We explain choices simply and never promise results that depend on things we cannot control.

How we work, in four steps

A simple path from first conversation to a product that keeps improving.

  1. 01

    Discover

    We learn your audience, goals and constraints.

    • Goals and audience call
    • Competitor and channel review
    • Scope, plan and timeline
  2. 02

    Design

    We shape the idea, the experience and the visual system.

    • Wireframes and prototypes
    • Visual direction and identity
    • Review and refine with you
  3. 03

    Build and launch

    We develop, test and release with care.

    • Development sprints and production
    • Testing and security checks
    • Launch and handover
  4. 04

    Grow

    We measure, learn and keep improving.

    • Analytics and monthly reporting
    • Content and campaign updates
    • Ongoing improvements

About Pixelbrahma FAQs

Who we are, where we work and how we start a project.

Ask us directly
What services does Pixelbrahma offer?

Pixelbrahma offers website design and development, mobile app development, digital marketing (social media management and content creation) and branding, including logo design, brochures, leaflets, magazines, package design, in-shop branding, outdoor advertising and TV commercials.

Do you work with businesses in Canada?

Yes. Our Brampton office supports businesses in the Greater Toronto Area and across Canada with web design, app development, digital marketing and branding.

How much does a website, app or branding project cost?

The cost depends on scope, features and timeline. Send a short brief through the contact form and we will reply with questions and a price range once we understand the goal.

How do I start a project with Pixelbrahma?

Send a short brief using the contact form or call us. We will reply with questions and a suggested scope.

What is Smolgoodi?

Smolgoodi is a product built by Pixelbrahma that helps home sellers in India list products and take orders through a shareable link, with orders arriving on WhatsApp.
